messages:
sophie_support: FYI got a report from a customer: their re-ranking requests are intermittently returning 500s when the input contains emojis. they included a sample payload and a curl repro. pinging @liya_engineer for triage. :wave:

rachel_customer: hey team — started seeing failures after upgrading our client lib. sample request attached. works most of the time but ~10% of requests are 500. no throttling in our logs. we only changed some unicode handling.

sophie_support: here's the payload they sent (copied from support ticket):
```json
{
  "query": "Find similar answers\u0000 😊",
  "candidates": ["Answer A", "Answer B", "An emoji answer 😅"],
  "top_k": 5
}
```

sophie_support: and the response from our API: 500 with body
```json
{
  "error": "internal_error",
  "message": "failed to decode request body: invalid UTF-8 sequence or NUL byte"
}
```

liya_engineer: thanks. stepping in. first guess: NUL (\u0000) in the JSON string is tripping our C++ text decoder in the ranking service. it should be rejected as a 400 though — looks like an uncaught exception in the score pipeline. can you paste the full request headers?

sophie_support: headers from curl repro:
```
POST /v1/rank/reorder HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 123
```

jake_reliability: adding context: we rolled the latest ranking model binary yesterday (2026-02-12 03:15 UTC). runtime changed to use the new utf8-fast C decoder. might be related.

liya_engineer: can reproduce locally. running the curl with the exact payload yields a crash in the scoring worker:
```
2026-02-13T14:05:01.234Z ERROR scoring_worker.cpp:312 handle_request failed: std::runtime_error: decode error: NUL byte in input
stack: 0x400f2a ...
```

liya_engineer: stack shows exception escape path that wasn't turned into an HTTP 400. looks like we throw deep in the tokenizer and the HTTP layer doesn't catch it -> 500.

liya_engineer: repro steps I ran:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rank/reorder -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"Hello\u0000 😊","candidates":["A","B"]}'
2) see 500 response and worker log shown above

sophie_support: customer said emoji-only inputs sometimes fail even without explicit \u0000 when coming from their mobile SDK. could be a surrogate pair / ill-formed UTF-8 sequence.

liya_engineer: yes, I also tried a malformed continuation byte and got a Python/unicode decode error in our tokenizer service: "UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x80 in position 5: invalid start byte" — same symptom.

infra-bot: Deploy report: ranking-worker v3.4.2 -> v3.5.0 deployed 2026-02-12T03:15Z (by @ci-bot). No automatic rollback.

jake_reliability: priority: high. this affects customers sending raw user text. impact: intermittent 500s and poor UX. assignment: liya to debug, jake to coordinate rollbacks if needed.

liya_engineer: plan: short-term -> add input validation at HTTP entry to detect invalid UTF-8 or NUL and return 400 with a clear error. long-term -> harden tokenizer to not throw and add unit tests covering surrogate halves and nul bytes.

liya_engineer: quick patch applied locally:
```diff
+ try:
+   payload_bytes = request.get_data()
+   payload_bytes.decode('utf-8')
+ except UnicodeDecodeError:
+   return make_response(jsonify({"error":"invalid_input","message":"request body contains invalid UTF-8"}), 400)
```

sophie_support: can we ship that as a hotfix? customer needs a workaround asap.

jake_reliability: if the patch only changes the HTTP layer and doesn't touch scoring logic we can do a canary deploy to staging then prod. create a rollout ticket and a revert plan.

liya_engineer: created BUG-5124 and PR #8342 with the HTTP validation. added unit tests + a regression test that posts a \u0000 inside JSON. requesting review from @jake_reliability.

sophie_support: communicated workaround to customer: strip NULs on client side and normalize to NFC. provided sample JS sanitizer: 
```js
function sanitize(s){ return s.replace(/\u0000/g, ''); }
```

rachel_customer: thanks — tried the sanitizer and errors stopped. can you keep me posted on the fix schedule? :pray:

jake_reliability: tentative plan: merge PR after review, canary to 5% traffic for 30m, then 100% if no regressions. timeline ~2-3 hours if reviews are quick.

liya_engineer: follow-ups:
- add explicit 400 for invalid utf8 / nul (PR #8342)
- add fuzz tests for boundary UTF sequences (ticket TEST-276)
- add observability metric for "decode_errors" to surface rate
- add note to API docs that strings must be valid UTF-8 without NUL bytes

sophie_support: i will send the customer an ETA and the workaround. marking this thread for follow-up after deploy. :thumbsup:

liya_engineer: merged and rolling out the HTTP validation canary now. will update with canary metrics.

jake_reliability: noted for postmortem if we see >0.2% errors after deploy.

infra-bot: Rollout started: ranking-http-validate v1.0 -> canary 5% (ID rl-2026-8342).

liya_engineer: canary logs clean so far (30m). no decode_errors in canary. ramping to 100%.

liya_engineer: full rollout complete. closing BUG-5124 after validating customer reported failure resolved.

sophie_support: customer confirmed fix on their side and our side. closing loop. :tada:
